title: data: the nested-relation condition refusal prints its route last, past the 500-character client cap, for a second-level relation, a dotted key and an empty object in where
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a measurement. The #27337 implementer found it (os-dev-report `6486007650` on #27337, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK`). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

## Symptom

`POST /api/v1/data/OBJECT/query` refuses a nested-relation condition in `where` with `400 INVALID_FILTER` when the condition names a second-level relation, uses a dotted key, or names no key at all. The refusal prints its route as the **last** sentence, so with an ordinary field name a client never reads it.

Measured with `tsx` at PR #27350's base, `origin/main` `6d7634a9`. The fixture used field `primary_account_owner` (21 chars), target `customer_account`, three keys and path `where.$and[1].$or[0].FIELD`:

| arm | message length | route |
|:--|--:|:--|
| second-level relation | 608 | last, past the 499-character cut |
| dotted key | 527 | last, past the cut |
| empty object | 508 | last, past the cut |
| undeclared key | 509 | before the last sentence (inside) |
| unregistered target | 447 | inside |

## Cause (the implementer's reading)

`packages/objectql/src/relation-filter-lowering.ts`, `relationConditionRefusalMessage`: the prescription comes after the verdict and the reasoning. This is the class #27098, #27173 and #27337 fixed for other producers.

A residue was noted but not filed. On a stress fixture (a 27-character object and target, a 32-character field, four keys, a three-deep path), five rows of the no-operator-object refusal still end at 502–528 after PR #27350. The cause is the shared head (context, field, keys, path), which takes about 270 characters before any arm's words. That is recorded in PR #27350's Acceptance notes. A fix that shortens the head (`describeObject` shows three keys) would close both.

## Expected

The same rule as #27098, #27173 and #27337: the prescription goes first at the producer, with margin inside the cap. The cap, truncation, code and status stay unchanged.

## Filing facts

- reach: any client of the public data door writing a nested-relation condition in `where` that reaches past one relation hop, uses a dotted key, or is empty.
- Dedupe: #27098, #27173 and #27337 are the same family on other producers (temporal-comparand, text-operator, no-operator-object). None covers `relation-filter-lowering.ts`. #20802 is the nested-relation lowering itself.
- Dedupe words: nested-relation condition refusal route truncated; second-level relation refusal $in route past client cap; relation-filter-lowering refusal prescription last.
